title: AuthorizedElderListV1
description: Paginated elders the caller may access in the requested mode, returned by GET /api/v1/me/authorized-elders. The server filters by role, care unit, assignment, relationship and validity window; document 10 section 4.6 forbids any client filter from widening that set.

care_unit_name.description: Care unit this authorization runs through, or null when the authorizing record names no care unit.

authorization_summary.description: Short description of why the elder is visible. Must not disclose other actors' identities.
